Both ended with the card showing the same "Read later" status, so your assumption holds — it's its own separate thing from labels and it stays visible on the card once I've marked it.

Version A feels more natural. Marking something to read later is a quick, in-the-moment decision — I'm usually just skimming and want to flag it in one tap right there on the card, without opening the editor. Version B works, but going into Edit details for something this small is more steps than it deserves. So let's go with A — the direct toggle on the card.

And I'll want the flip side of this to be just as quick later: being able to un-mark it, or mark it read, straight from the card too.
